title: A sequential regularized piecewise affine algorithm for nonconvex nonsmooth multicomposite optimization in RNN training
summary: This paper focuses on a class of nonconvex nonsmooth multicomposite optimization problems for training RNNs (Recurrent Neural Networks). We first establish easily verifiable conditions under which an approximate first-order d-stationary point of the problem is guaranteed to be an approximate second-order d-stationary point. Subsequently, we propose a sequential regularized piecewise affine algorithm, SRPA, that minimizes a regularized piecewise affine function at each iteration, where the idea of active-set strategy is incorporated to reduce the computational cost per iteration.
